title: Remove unwanted packed XLS cell records and the source-open SST locator pointer vector
decision: retained, implemented in litchi-xls; retained cross-query indexing and framing fusion remain deferred
code_state: crates/litchi-xls only; no public API, limit, error, fence, or output-byte change; no new unsafe or dependency
reason_codes: 0651 row 12 identified MulRk and MulBlank as 60,575 of 127,072 corpus cell values (47.7%); an unwanted selected-cell query still built and dropped one 88-byte CellRecord per packed cell

the packed range validator already proves complete payload length, count, and column coverage, so a measured visitor can validate every XF and materialize only a selected target while preserving refusal order
the source-open SST locator scan already owns the RecordRef slice; constructing a second Vec<&[u8]> only copied one fat pointer per SST record and did not change the bytes walked
0651 row 11 remains gated by ADR 0005: a retained sheet index and snapshot chain hint need a bounded weighted evictable clean-value cache, which no crate supplies
0633 measured the two framing passes at about 1.6% each and froze fusion because its coverage proof and refusal order must remain intact

accepted_evidence.packed_census: 0641's frozen corpus census: 126 fixtures, 127,072 cell values, 33,758 MulBlank cells and 26,817 MulRk cells
accepted_evidence.locator_allocations: the existing sst_scan_allocations counting allocator over 54016.xls and WithCustomViews.xls, base 5fa92d7ce versus this branch: 246/754,968 to 245/754,520 and 208/153,205 to 207/152,997 allocations/bytes
accepted_evidence.allocation_floor: the exact one-allocation deltas are 448 bytes for 28 SST records and 208 bytes for 13 records; &[u8] is a 16-byte fat pointer on the measured target
accepted_evidence.sst_differential: the pinned SST digest remains 0x9cb14f5daa02eebc; 117 corpus fixtures index identically and the four malformed fixtures are refused identically
accepted_evidence.tests: cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo check -p litchi-xls, focused packed/SST tests, sst_scan_allocations, and the complete cargo test -p litchi-xls suite; 1,068 unit tests and all integration/doc tests pass

accepted_costs.packed_validation: every packed cell is still visited and its XF is validated; only target CellRecord construction and RK numeric conversion move behind the coordinate match
accepted_costs.locator_scan: the open still scans the whole SST/Continue chain and retains its segment and entry locator vectors; only the temporary payload fat-pointer vector is removed
accepted_costs.runtime_shape: the direct RecordRef cursor keeps the same logical offsets, source offsets, framing and error order; no source read set changes are claimed

known_gaps.no_timing_floor: no release timing, cycles, instruction, RSS, or physical-I/O run was retained; deterministic allocation evidence is used and no speedup is claimed
known_gaps.retained_index: row 11 is deferred until ADR 0005's bounded weighted evictable cache exists and can account for retained clean values
known_gaps.framing: row 12's two framing passes remain deferred under 0633's coverage-proof and refusal-order gate
known_gaps.open_scan: open still performs the complete string-table scan to build locators; this change removes pointer scratch only and does not make locator construction lazy
known_gaps.corpus_scope: the packed-cell share and SST index evidence are from the checked-in XLS corpus; no real-producer expansion or cross-platform run was performed

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, wall-clock, cold-cache, physical-I/O, RSS, concurrency-scaling or cross-platform result
any retained-index or snapshot-chain cache design

provenance.host: AMD EPYC, Linux; shared multi-agent host
provenance.note: the before checkout was restored to read-only after its allocation leg; no release binary was built because this change makes no timing claim
